queries_run: Shopify agentic commerce AI agents threat to ecommerce platforms 2026

findings.claim: Shopify 10-K 列示可能的替代/競爭方案（電商軟體、CMS、支付、POS、市集等），並稱正以 Sidekick 與 Agentic Storefronts（跨 AI 平台的代理式商品發現與結帳）納入新興 AI 技術。
findings.excerpt: Shopify provides a suite of AI-enabled features integrated across the Shopify platform, including Sidekick, our AI-enabled commerce assistant, and Agentic Storefronts, which enables agent-assisted product discovery and checkout across a number of AI platforms.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：大型科技平台可能整合競爭功能或限制第三方存取其用戶資料，影響商家行銷與銷售及平台需求。
findings.excerpt: large technology platforms have imposed and are considering imposing, or may provide their users the ability to impose, restrictions on the ability of other parties to access or use data from their customers and users.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋僅得聚合/部落格來源，未取得可逐字引用之第三方替代技術證據；agentic commerce 去中介化風險見 Baillie Gifford 評論但未讀原文。

clues.claim: Baillie Gifford 評論：AI 代理接手搜尋比較購買時，靠發現與客戶旅程變現的平台面臨被顛覆風險，對他者則是機會。
